description: Compare 2 to 4 known Paragon product handles through the existing read-only Paragon catalog connection. Returns store-provided descriptions, per-variant prices, options and availableForSale with complete bounded pagination. Optional country and language select API context; no physical stock or reservation is implied. Obtain handles from native Shopify catalog tools or product URLs first. Use native Shopify tools for variant selection and commerce.

country.description: Known destination country. Omission uses the API default context.

language.description: Requested Storefront language code; unsupported context fails explicitly.

name: paragon_compare_products
